research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: BrowserStack is researching remote device infrastructure for web and app testing, as seen in titles like 'Remote device infrastructure' and 'Automation testing with remote device infrastructure.' Abstracts describe enabling developers to select and control remote devices in datacenters, stream device displays, and automate testing via SDKs. Additional work includes features for accessibility, media transfer, network status simulation, and multisession support, highlighting focus areas in remote testing, automation, and device management.

overview_description.description: BrowserStack is a software testing platform that runs more than two million tests per day across 15 global data centers. It enables Microsoft, Twitter, Barclays, Expedia, and more than 25,000 customers to produce high-quality software quickly by transferring testing to the cloud. Its technology delivers rapid access to over 2,000 real mobile devices and browsers via a highly reliable cloud architecture that scales seamlessly as testing requirements grow. BrowserStack enables development and QA teams to move quickly while providing an exceptional client experience.

about_short_description.short_description: BrowserStack is a technology-based platform that specializes in powering web and app testing such as testing iOS and Android mobile apps.

product.name: BrowserStack Test Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for testing websites and mobile apps across browsers, operating systems, and real devices, with test automation, accessibility, visual testing, and test management capabilities.

product.name: Automate
product.description: A cloud browser automation grid for running automated website and web application tests across browser, operating-system, and device combinations.

product.name: App Automate
product.description: A cloud service for automated testing of iOS and Android applications on real mobile devices, including functional and regression test execution.

product.name: Live
product.description: A browser-based service for manually testing websites and web applications on different real browsers, operating systems, and screen configurations.

product.name: App Live
product.description: A remote real-device testing service for manually evaluating iOS and Android mobile applications across device and operating-system configurations.

product.name: Accessibility Testing
product.description: A web accessibility testing solution for identifying and managing WCAG and ADA compliance issues in websites and web applications.
